title: The Value Semantics Layer: Enabling Machine-Understandable Databases for Agentic AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.23629v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As data systems increasingly support autonomous LLM-powered agents alongside human analysts, they require richer semantic infrastructure bridging analytical concepts and analytical operations. Existing metadata systems expose schemas, catalogs, lineage, and governance information, but provide limited support for representing operational semantics. We propose the Value Semantics Layer (VSL), an architectural abstraction that externalizes value semantics as persistent, planner-visible infrastructure. VSL introduces Value Semantic Types (VSTs), reusable operational semantic assertions capturing distributional, relational, process, quantitative, and policy-grounded semantics. Unlike descriptive metadata, VSTs enable planners to validate analytical operations, select appropriate operators, and guide analytical workflows. We present the motivation, formalization, architecture, and prototype realizations of VSL, and outline a research agenda

translated_title: 值语义层：为智能体AI实现机器可理解的数据库
translated_abstract: 随着数据系统日益同时支持自主的LLM驱动智能体与人类分析师，它们需要更丰富的语义基础设施来连接分析概念与分析操作。现有的元数据系统提供模式、目录、血缘和治理信息，但对表示操作语义的支持有限。我们提出值语义层（Value Semantics Layer, VSL），这是一种架构抽象，将值语义外部化为持久的、规划器可见的基础设施。VSL引入了值语义类型（Value Semantic Types, VSTs），这是一类可复用的操作语义断言，涵盖分布语义、关系语义、过程语义、定量语义以及基于策略的语义。与描述性元数据不同，VSTs使规划器能够验证分析操作、选择合适的算子并引导分析工作流。我们阐述了VSL的动机、形式化、架构与原型实现，并勾勒出相关研究议程。
tldr: 该论文提出值语义层（VSL）架构，通过可复用的值语义类型（VSTs）将操作语义外部化为规划器可见的持久基础设施，使LLM智能体能够验证分析操作、选择合适算子并引导分析工作流。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Value Semantics Layer (VSL), an architectural abstraction with reusable Value Semantic Types (VSTs) that externalizes operational semantics as persistent, planner-visible infrastructure, enabling LLM agents to validate analytical operations, select appropriate operators, and guide analytical workflows.
